notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 3
notes.notes:
[list]
[Fixed Nanobot tower and Nanobot crashing game]
[Start wave button remains in place when you click on it trying to place an illegal tile]
[Only one tooltip at a time is shown]
[Burn overhaul]
[list]
[Flame Tower always inflicts burn with 20% chance]
[New Firestarter perk increases general burn damage]
[Base burn damage reduced]
[Midnight Oil now increases damage against burning targets]
[Immolation now doubles burn duration]
[/list]
[Damage correctly resets heal timers of enemies]
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 2
notes.notes:

- Fixed typo bug in boss wave hint
